behavioral_cases.name: append
behavioral_cases.input: previous snapshot is an exact prefix of the next snapshot

behavioral_cases.name: repeat
behavioral_cases.input: the next snapshot repeats records in the overlap window

behavioral_cases.name: truncation_or_rotation
behavioral_cases.input: snapshot count decreases or the previous prefix no longer matches
behavioral_cases.required_adapter_result: recover from the bounded overlap identity window without replaying the full snapshot

behavioral_cases.name: terminal
behavioral_cases.input: authoritative status is a terminal allowlisted value
behavioral_cases.required_adapter_result: settle lifecycle independently of trace ingestion

behavioral_cases.name: unavailable
behavioral_cases.input: status or log transport returns no valid payload
behavioral_cases.required_adapter_result: return a typed unavailable observation; trace failure does not change analysis outcome

privacy_notes: dag, task, app, resource, input, output, tool, user, path, and URL fields are private
content is never copied, summarized, or exposed by the generic adapter
unknown fields and record forms remain private diagnostics
